name: Sinnuris

queries.query: Sinnuris Egypt cadastral parcel map official Fayoum land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) service pages for paper, digital, historical and topographic maps. ESA material describes cadastral/ownership-map production and its digital-map workflow, but no public anonymous Sinnuris parcel-vector endpoint was exposed.

queries.result: Arabic first-party discovery identified ESA and its official Fayoum topographic-map guide. The guide names مركز سنورس and describes Fayoum map coverage at city/village scales, while the ESA digital-map page requires a formal purchase request; no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA), Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation; its official site describes cadastral/ownership mapping, map production, and digital-map services.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: ESA is a national survey/map custodian. First-party evidence names Fayoum and Sinnuris in a topographic-map guide, but no city-local registry office, public cadastral viewer, or anonymous Sinnuris parcel service was evidenced; registryFound therefore remains null.
officialSourceAssessment.scopeNote: National agency prose and a Fayoum map-coverage guide are not treated as proof of a public citywide parcel API or current vector coverage.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved ESA services.aspx, sellingmaproomdigital.aspx, paper_maps_search.aspx, egypt_maps.aspx, testmap.aspx, and the ESA topographic-map guide/search evidence. The current public ESA pages are legacy ASP.NET forms. The digital-map page exposes scale choices and states that requested GIS/CAD/PDF/JPG/orthophoto products are supplied after a formal request, inspection, cost estimate and payment. No public map JavaScript/configuration or parcel feature endpoint was exposed. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official service index loaded. It links paper, digital, historical and topographic-map services plus cadastral-related survey services; no parcel API was embedded.

Current HTML and scripts inspected. The page is an ASP.NET postback form with map-scale choices (1:50000, 1:2500, 1:5000). Its procedure requires a written request specifying location, scale, layers, output format and projection, followed by inspection, quotation and payment. No public parcel viewer, service URL, schema, CRS response or anonymous parcel geometry was exposed.
ASP.NET form loaded with scale choices including 1:2500, but the dependent map-name control was empty until interactive postback. It is a map-catalogue/search page, not a parcel-vector service.
Official national map downloads/directory loaded. No Sinnuris parcel layer or machine-readable cadastral geometry was exposed.
Official image-map page loaded. It is a static directorate/administrative map and does not expose parcel features or a public map API.

Official guide identifies Fayoum coverage and names مركز سنورس; it describes city maps at 1:5000 and village maps at 1:2500. This establishes map-product scope, not a downloadable parcel-vector response or current citywide parcel coverage.

Native-language search returned official Fayoum references mentioning Sinnuris, but no reachable public cadastral viewer or safe parcel-vector service was identified in bounded discovery. No local registry evidence was promoted to registryFound.
